confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors (beer, coffee, inexpensive and mid-range meals) rest on crowdsourced Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost and listing figures for Varanasi, converted at roughly 94.5 INR per USD (implied by a source page), with probably ±25-30% uncertainty. Cocktail and wine_glass are weaker: they draw on one Expatistan cocktail estimate, Indian hotel-bar menus from other cities, and a bottle-price estimate, with the cocktail anchor also set against the beer relationship. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation search was run. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries of RBA data, not from a directly opened RBA page, and I ran two FX searches against an allowance of one (total searches stayed within six), so verify it against the RBA F11.1 series before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city basis was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Varanasi-specific crowdsourced figures, with cocktail and wine anchors partly inferred from beer pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a mid-sized north Indian heritage and pilgrimage city with ghat-area guesthouse supply.
